code_examples.section: ltm rule command PSC tower id
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSC::tower_id
       Get or set tower id.

SYNOPSIS
       PSC::tower_id (TOWER_ID)?

DESCRIPTION
       The PSC::tower_id command gets the tower id or sets the tower id when the optional value is given.

       Syntax

       PSC::tower_id

	   * Retrieve the tower id.

       PSC::tower_id 

	   * Set the tower id.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the tower id when no argument is given.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
